name: 12-week half marathon, sub 1:55
description: Four runs a week: two easy runs, one quality session and a long run. Volume builds from 25 km to 40 km, never more than 10% over the recent peak, with cutback weeks in weeks 4 and 8, then a two-week taper.
author: Curro example
